address: Markham Mews, Markham Crescent, York YO31 8NS
lead_profile_text: Existing property looking for higher return
property_situation: Vacant 1-bed mews house owned by her parents (no mortgage), being furnished by Rebecca and her sister; coming off a planned long let
primary_blocker: Setup cost and process (Action Plan S3); sister not on call; upfront furnishing spend
language_signals: it's a big chunk of money that you're putting up front
how luxurious we kind of need to go with it
all the law changes in terms of making it a bit more difficult for landlords with long-term
any guidance would be definitely appreciated

delay_signals.trigger_phrase: It's currently unfurnished, but me and my sister are in the process of getting furniture
delay_signals.context: Explaining the mews was meant to be a long let but they chose short let
delay_signals.timeline_given: Target on market before end of October; sister's availability uncertain

green_light_signals.trigger_phrase: on the market definitely before the end of October

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit on your current situation and situation with the property, and then we can go through the figures and our service if it lines up with what you're looking for.
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: we can go through some figures and go through our service
meeting_flow.income_intro: for the 1-bed flat, we're looking at sort of gross revenue about £51,000, which is about £4,200 a month... payout... about £26,400 per year
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: One thing that's probably worth covering... how long does it take to sort of get there?
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: free setup guide + case study links offered; 'I'll touch base in a couple of weeks, see how the refurb's going'
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: No meeting 2; informal check-in in ~2 weeks

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Why is there such a big difference between the 4,000? The £2,000
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Walked through 3 costs: platform commissions, cleaning/laundry ~18%, management 15%
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: that makes a lot more sense

lead_responses.what_lead_said: How long do you expect, or is it a bit too difficult to say?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: 18 months to 2.5 years to reach peak; projected average after year one; 20% lower until 20-30 reviews

lead_responses.what_lead_said: what's actually involved in that 15%, like what do you do?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: End-to-end: platforms, dynamic pricing, screening, check-in/out, cleaning, maintenance; owner sees calendar, Slack, monthly statement

lead_responses.what_lead_said: how luxurious we kind of need to go with it
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Case study links, free setup guide, 'minimalistic but looks like effort'
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: any guidance would be definitely appreciated

lead_responses.what_lead_said: What do you mean by snagging?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Small things a guest might notice, e.g. wonky radiator; comes back in snagging report

conversion_gaps.gap: Furnishing standard/spend vs return for a premium York market
conversion_gaps.evidence: how luxurious we kind of need to go; Action Plan S3 'setup cost and process'
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Send case-study photos, free setup guide and furniture-pack supplier; give a concrete budget range

conversion_gaps.gap: Sister (co-decision-maker) and parents (legal owners/signatories) not on the call
conversion_gaps.evidence: sister missed call; parents own the property
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Send summary/action plan so Rebecca can relay; offer 3-way follow-up

positive_shift_moments.lead_response: that makes a lot more sense

positive_shift_moments.what_caused_shift: Free setup guide and furniture-pack supplier

friction_moments.what_caused_friction: Zac said 'the 1-bed flat' when the property is the 1-bed mews; omitted '+ VAT', £42/mo software fee and £1,000 early-exit fee
friction_moments.recovery_attempted: Disclosed in action plan and email
